selection: Every complete-NER source document containing a previously resolved EVALUATED_ON pair in locked train39/dev40, in source order. No model error/score selection, new collection, replacement or reserved-test use.
goal: Remove unsupported component/family benchmark attribution from future plain binary supervision while preserving the evidence and original labels. This is source-only label quality control, not model optimization by dev scores.
meaning: EVALUATED_ON links the reported measured method/model/protocol configuration to its benchmark. It does not imply independent ablation, causal improvement, good performance or benchmark training. Reported baseline measurement remains positive even when its score is poor.
retentionPolicy: Keep a named measured method, explicit reported model baseline or explicitly compared evaluation protocol. A measured combined method may be retained only when the head unambiguously identifies that reported configuration; repeated names are record-local correlated mentions. No independent-ablation prerequisite is introduced.
retractionPolicy: If a binary edge loses a required unnamed combination/configuration, maps a measurement to an internal operation without its own reported attribution, or generalizes a specific measured model to a generic family, explicitly return it to UNRESOLVED. Never manufacture NO_RELATION from lack of measurement. This does not assert that the component was never used, contributed nothing or could not be evaluated.
revisionPolicy: Only existing EVALUATED_ON pairs may be kept, retracted to UNRESOLVED, or explicitly repaired for a clipped evidence span while retaining label/reason. Cover all such source pairs exactly once. No additions, substitutions, entity changes, same-key duplicate judgments, or revisions of USED_FOR/NO_RELATION/previous UNRESOLVED. Bind whole source and prior receipt hashes; record each changed prior/new pair and their canonical hashes, and retain literal excerpt plus rationale. Evidence-only repair must include the original evidence and the complete supporting excerpt without changing any label.
entityPolicy: All train58/dev19 source references, NER fields, quarantines and candidate inventories remain unchanged. Previously resolved non-EVALUATED_ON and previously unresolved pairs remain exact. No implicit reannotation.
reviewPolicy: Actual whole-source AI judgment followed by actual root-agent self-review; a read-only parallel AI audit may inform it but is not independent human gold. Fresh generation and one review are distinct from immutable upstream receipt binding. Unselected receipts remain byte-identical.
experiment: Label attribution audit/retraction, strict BIO and marked-pair encoding preflight only. No training, model inference, rescoring previous predictions, new model metrics, reserved-test semantic access, graph/database writes or service restart. Future training/comparison must lock the revised snapshots and disclose changed denominators.
